name: SoarTour
summary:
SoarTour lets you fly freely over real cities and landscapes all around the world in VR.

CHOOSE WHERE TO GO
- Spin the globe and tap a spot, or pick from 45 featured places such as Tokyo, Paris, New York, Mount Fuji and the Grand Canyon. You arrive in the sky with the landmark right in front of you.
- Search any place or address by voice or keyboard. Recent searches are saved.

FLY WITH CONTROLLERS
- Super jump: hop lightly in place to shoot up into the sky
- Thrust: pull the trigger to fire jets from your
